Condition.title: Condition
Condition.description: Condition is a structured, declarative representation of an Octelium Condition. Unlike the core Condition which is written directly as a CEL or OPA expression, it is built out of typed building blocks which makes it suitable for the tools that need to programmatically construct, inspect and render the authorization rules (e.g. a UI). The Cluster compiles it into an equivalent core Condition which can also be previewed via the GetCoreCondition method.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Conditio.description: Session matches a specific Session

aal.title: AAL
aal.description: AAL is the authenticator assurance level (AAL) of the authentication as defined by NIST SP 800-63B

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Conditio.description: SessionAuthenticationAAL matches the authenticator assurance level (AAL) of the Session's current authentication

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Conditio.description: SessionAuthenticationCredAuthenticatorAAGUID matches the Sessions whose FIDO Authenticator has a specific model identifier (i.e. AAGUID)

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Conditio.title: Session Authentication Cred Authenticator FIDO Attestation Verified

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Conditio.title: Session Authentication Cred Authenticator FIDO Passkey
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Conditio.description: SessionAuthenticationCredAuthenticatorFIDOPasskey matches the Sessions whose FIDO Authenticator is a discoverable credential (i.e. a passkey)

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Conditio.title: Session Authentication Cred Authenticator FIDO User Present

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Conditio.description: SessionAuthenticationCredentialType matches the type of the Credential that the Session authenticated with

type.title: Type
type.description: Type is the type of the Session

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Conditio.description: SessionType matches the type of the Session

exact.description: Exact matches when the field's value is exactly equal to this value.

prefix.description: Prefix matches when the field's value starts with this value.

suffix.description: Suffix matches when the field's value ends with this value.

contains.description: Contains matches when the field's value contains this value.

in.description: In matches when the field's value is one of a set of values.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Conditio.title: String Match
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Conditio.description: StringMatch is a reusable matcher for string-valued request fields. The server translates the selected variant into the corresponding CEL string operation.

values.description: Values is the set of the values that are matched.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Conditio.title: In
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Conditio.description: In matches when the field's value is one of a set of values

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Conditio.title: String Set Match
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Conditio.description: StringSetMatch is a restricted matcher for normalized string codes. It intentionally supports only exact values and explicit allowlists.

timestamp.description: Timestamp is the date that the current time must be after.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Conditio.description: TimeAfter matches only after a specific point in time

timestamp.description: Timestamp is the date that the current time must be before.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Conditio.title: Time Before
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Conditio.description: TimeBefore matches only before a specific point in time

timezone.description: Timezone is an optional IANA timezone name. An empty value means UTC.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Conditio.title: Time Day Type
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Conditio.description: TimeDayType matches the current day as a weekday or weekend day.

exact.description: Exact matches when the field's value is equal to this value.

lessThan.description: LessThan matches when the field's value is less than this value.

lessThanOrEqual.description: LessThanOrEqual matches when the field's value is less than or equal to this value.

greaterThan.description: GreaterThan matches when the field's value is greater than this value.

greaterThanOrEqual.description: GreaterThanOrEqual matches when the field's value is greater than or equal to this value.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Conditio.title: U Int Match
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Conditio.description: UIntMatch is a reusable matcher for unsigned integer-valued request fields. It is suitable for both uint32 and uint64 RequestContext fields.

userRef.description: UserRef is a reference to the User that is matched.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Conditio.title: User
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Conditio.description: User matches a specific User

type.title: Type

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Conditio.title: User Type
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Conditio.description: UserType matches the type of the User

of.description: Of is the list of the child Conditions.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Conditio.description: None matches only when none of its child Conditions matches

expression.description: Expression is the Expression that is negated.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Conditio.description: Not matches when its Expression does not match

apiVersion.description: APIVersion is the API version of the reference resource

kind.description: Kind is the resource kind. A kind is unique per an APIVersion.

uid.description: UID is the resource object UID. A UID is unique across the entire Cluster.

name.description: Name is the resource object name. A name is unique per a certain kind.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is the resourceVersion of the resource.
